newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi may invest over 500 mln dmk in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Audi may invest over 500 mln dmk in Brazil.

text.p: Audi AG, the luxury car unit of Germany's Volkswagen AG, said on Thursday that it could invest well over 500 million marks in a Brazilian production plant but that no final decision has been made.
Audi has planned to build a factory in Brazil where the new compact A3 model for Latin American markets would be produced.
A final contract over the plant is expected by the end of next week, Audi officials have said.
"The investment will be more than 500 million marks but it could also be clearly above that level," an Audi spokesman told Reuters in response to an enquiry.
Industry sources have said that investment in a new Latin American factory could run into the billions of marks.
The Audi spokesman also confirmed a report in the German newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung that the factory in Brazil could have production of about 30,000 of the Audi A3s as well as the VW Jetta model.
